Location: The Netherlands | Full-time | Open to candidates currently based in Spain Are you experienced in Revit or BIM and interested in moving your career into the high-voltage and energy infrastructure sector? As an Electrical BIM Modeler, you will work on the design and development of high-voltage substations in the Netherlands. You will translate electrical engineering input into accurate 3D models and technical drawings, working closely with Primary and Secondary Engineers, Civil Engineers and other BIM specialists. You will work on both new substations and extensions or modifications of existing installations. What will you do? You will be responsible for developing and maintaining BIM models for electrical substation projects. Your work will include: Creating and updating 3D BIM models for high-voltage substations; Modelling electrical equipment and substation components in Autodesk Revit; Working with equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, busbars, cable routes and supporting structures; Producing layouts, sections, details and technical drawings from the 3D model; Adding and maintaining technical information and object data within the BIM environment; Coordinating the electrical model with Civil, Structural and other engineering disciplines; Identifying clashes and design inconsistencies; Processing design changes throughout different project phases; Supporting Primary and Secondary Engineers with model-based engineering; Contributing to BIM standards, libraries and modelling workflows; Checking models and drawings for quality, completeness and constructability. Arbeidsvoorwaarden €3,500 – €4,500 gross per month, depending on experience; 22 vacation days + 13 ATV days: 35 days off per year; Hybrid working possibilities and a home-working allowance; Commuting allowance or business public-transport card; A strong pension scheme; Technical and personal development through professional training; Opportunities to develop towards SeniBIM Modeler, BIM Coordinator or Electrical Engineering; Bicycle leasing and fitness schemes; International and multidisciplinary engineering projects; A professional but informal working environment. Why move from Spain to the Netherlands? The Netherlands is investing heavily in the expansion and reinforcement of its electricity grid. This creates long-term engineering opportunities in substations and high-voltage infrastructure. For an experienced electrical BIM professional, this role offers the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in a sector with a substantial long-term project pipeline. Functie-eisen We are interested in candidates with either an engineering or technical vocational background. Relevant Spanish qualifications include, for example: Grado en Ingeniería Eléctrica; Grado en Ingeniería Electrónica Industrial y Automática; Grado en Ingeniería en Tecnologías Industriales; Técnico Superior en Proyectos de Sistemas Electrotécnicos y Automatizados (CFGS); Older Ingeniero Técnico Industrial qualifications; Or another relevant electrical, industrial or technical qualification. More important than the exact title of your qualification is your technical understanding and experience with BIM/Revit. What do you bring? Experience with Autodesk Revit in an engineering environment; Experience as a BIM Modeler, Revit Modeler, CAD Designer or Electrical Designer; Ability to understand electrical layouts and technical drawings; Interest in substations, electrical grids, industrial electrical systems or energy infrastructure; Structured and accurate working methods; Ability to work within a multidisciplinary engineering team; Good working English. Experience with AutoCAD, Navisworks, Solibri, Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360 or similar tools is an advantage. Previous substation experience is highly valued, but not essential if you already have strong electrical and Revit/BIM experience. Hier kom je te werken You will work in a multidisciplina
